about: The listed edits of the CSS port (plan.md 3.9, Part O.5). scripts/port-proof.mjs proves each sheet's files under src/styles/<dir>/ equal the old sheet at `commit` minus these edits. Line numbers are the old sheet's. mode: whole = ported whole minus `remove` edits; part = only `keep` ranges (O.5 names what is kept); borrow = a left-out sheet, only the rules kept screens borrow (the class sweep). Groups: print and /p/, versions, edit lock, commission version rail, commission chat column (left out by O.5); partial sheet; borrowed; token pin (OQ10); button fix (O.5).

sweep.about: The class sweep (O.5): every class token in the old components reachable by import from `roots` (the kept routes), not walking into `notWalked` (out-of-scope modules, Drop and Defer features); of reports/CompareModal.jsx only Pane, which the census lens mounts. A left-out rule (a left-out sheet, or outside the families a partial sheet keeps) whose selector could match those classes is borrowed: the `borrowed` keep edits. These were found and not borrowed.

notBorrowed.reason: Claude Unleashed's sandbox (the gold view pill, Before/After and the changes rail): deferred (plan 1.4; D2, F4; OQ4). Returns with its feature.
The slot under the Ask Claude bubble, which is not rebuilt (plan 1.4).
Set by App.jsx only on /workflows, which is out of scope.
ClientsDashboard.jsx's Reminders column and inline new-client form: reminders wait with the Radar (I88), and ＋ New client opens the New client dialog (§8.3, CL12).
Their only rules need an ancestor no kept screen renders (.rpt-ideal-add, .jv-caret), so they never matched.
